description: Create a ComputeGpu account. Requires the human's email. Returns an API key (shown once) and unlocks all ComputeGpu tools in this session. Before the first deploy the owner verifies a card ($0, no charge). Ask the human for their email before calling.

email.description: The human owner's email. The account and receipts are tied to it.

tenant.description: Short lowercase slug, e.g. "my-agent" (3-64 chars, a-z 0-9 -)

name: computegpu_signup
